RAJSHAHI, Oct 12, 2022 (BSS)- Prospect of exporting mangoes from Rajshahi region is very bright as both acreage and yearly yield of the delicious fruit has been rising gradually for the last couple of years in the region.

Triple-cropping paddy fields are gradually being converted into mango orchards commercially because the seasonal fruit is being adjudged as more profitable compared to the grain crops at present.
